svg.text: Gemma 4 Cross-Layer KV-Sharing Topology in Decoupled Cross-Attention
Only KV-Owner layers compute dedicated Cross-KV states. KV-Shared layers borrow stationary (K_cross, V_cross) from Designated Anchors.

g.text: PANEL A: GEMMA 4 E2B (35 Layers · 15 KV-Owners / 20 Shared)
KV-Cache Memory Reduction: 57.14% (20 / 35 layers reuse Anchor KV)
← L15–L34 borrow Cross-KV states from Anchor L13 (Sliding) & L14 (Global Full)
PANEL B: GEMMA 4 E4B (42 Layers · 24 KV-Owners / 18 Shared)
KV-Cache Memory Reduction: 42.86% (18 / 42 layers reuse Anchor KV)
← L24–L41 borrow Cross-KV states from Anchor L22 (Sliding) & L23 (Global Full)
